summary: Package ships an author-owned SSH private key for the author's build server
details: cli.js embeds a base64-encoded RSA private key in a CONFIG.encodedSSHKey constant. At runtime the CLI decodes it to a temp file with mode 0600 and invokes `ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -i <key> ubuntu@79.72.65.161 "<command>"` to run auth/build steps on the author's signing server at 79.72.65.161. The shipped credential authorizes SSH access to infrastructure owned by the package author. The package does not read installer-side secrets (no ~/.aws, ~/.ssh, ~/.npmrc, env-var scraping), has no install/preinstall/postinstall lifecycle hook, does not fetch or execute remote code, and does not relay caller-supplied data to a non-obvious destination. Installing or importing the package does not compromise the installer's host; the exposed key's blast radius is confined to the author's own server.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
